questions.stem: What is adhesion in the context of water transport in xylem?

options.text: The attraction between water molecules and the xylem vessel walls
The attraction between water molecules and each other
The evaporation of water from leaf surfaces
The absorption of water by root hair cells

questions.explanation: Adhesion is the attraction between water molecules and the walls of the xylem vessels. This helps prevent the water column from breaking and assists in maintaining the continuous transpiration stream.
